text:
maya: quick heads-up — i pushed a tiny docs PR to fix the SDK snippet for KV prefetch + quant profile guidance: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4312

sam: checking it now. can we also add a short migration note for v2 quant profiles? there are a couple corner cases with dtype/scale that folks hit. @docs-team :eyes:

eli: skimmed. main issue is the python snippet uses `prefetch=True` which is wrong — should be `kv_prefetch=True`. left an inline comment on the PR. also one of the links pointed to the old `/optimize` path, updated to `/optimize/toolkit`.

maya: thanks — good catch. i updated the snippet and added a tiny migration blurb under examples/migrations.md. snippet now looks like:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.generate("summarize ...", model="rwv2-large", kv_prefetch=True, batch_size=8, quant_profile="v2-medium")
```

jen: will add a short paragraph to migration guide about quant profile name changes + recommended batch sizes for short sequences (batch_size=4..8). also will add a curl example for people not using the SDK.

sam: tiny nit — add note about sequence length and batch sizing (short sequences -> smaller batches) and mention tradeoff with latency. otherwise LGTM.

docs-bot: PR #4312 CI: docs-lint ✅, linkcheck ✅, preview generated at https://deploy-preview-4312--docs.redwood.ai

eli: :shipit: merge after jen's migration paragraph. maya can you take final review? i'll help with the changelog entry once merged.

maya: will do final pass in the morning. i also fixed two dead links and added an explicit example for `quant_profile: v2-medium` in the config table. will ping when merged. :thumbsup:
